messages:
ana: Kicking off CoAction 'SilkRoad' joint perf/W sweep. Primary goals: map perf-per-watt across V/F bins, validate 4-bit quant path with KV cache hot prefixes, and produce a concise ops playbook for the marketplace image. Working notes: https://go/redwood/partnerships/silkroad-notes

mike: +1. Plan: (1) single-board calibration, (2) canary A/B (stock vs coaction-prefetch), (3) cluster sweep (n=4), (4) 24h regression soak. Dry-run Mon 07:00 PT.

sophia: We saw VRM oscillation at sustained seq>768 previously. For sweep we'll lock fan curve to partner-reco and collect per-rail telemetry. Also capture KV cache hit ratio and prefix distributions.

coaction-eng: We'll ship two instrumented SilkRoad boards and a firmware build (sr-vrm-stable-1). Firmware s3://coaction/silkroad/fw/sr-v1/sha256=11aa22bb. Bench harness attached to emit rails + nvml power.

bench-bot: automated: tag artifacts with run_id and bench_tag. Template: run_id=silkroad-<YYYYMMDD>-<board>-<kernel> bench_tag=coaction-silk-v1. Include firmware_sha and reservation_id.

ana: Ops note: we'll reserve the "partner-dedicated" pool to avoid noisy neighbors. Mike, can you post the reservation id when done? Model weights pinned to redwood/llama-7b@v1.3-quant for parity.

mike: Reservation posted: rsv-2026-12-14-silk-4 (internal link). Also propose capturing three kernel variants: upstream-stock, coaction-prefetch, and coaction-prefetch+microcode-dvfs. A/B/C to isolate effect.

coaction-eng: Good call. Prefetch patch reduces L1 eviction in our sims. microcode-dvfs is low-risk. We'll canary both on a single board. Uploading board serials now.

sophia: Data capture checklist: nvml power sampling=0.5s, /sys/class/hwmon, ipmi sensors, per-rail current, perf counters: L1D_PREFETCH, L2_RQSTS.MISS, LLC_REFERENCES. Capture p50/p95/p99, throughput steady-state at batch=1 and batch=12.

bench-bot: reminder: include bench_tag and run_id in artifact metadata. Use naming convention to support automated parsing.

ana: Traffic shape: mixed seq distribution [32,128,512] weights [0.5,0.3,0.2], 12% prefix-cache hits, poisson arrival. For offline runs use batch=12 steady-state windows.

mike: Perf snippet for canary: ```bash
./run_bench.sh --model llama-7b --seq 512 --iter 25 --sample-power 0.5 --out artifacts/silk-board1.json
./collect_perf.sh --counters L1D_PREFETCH,L2_RQSTS.MISS,LLC_REFERENCES --sample 0.5 --out artifacts/silk-perf.json
```

coaction-eng: Board list uploaded: s3://coaction/silkroad/boards/serials.csv. Firmware sha: sha256=11aa22bb. We'll be on-call for canary and happy to co-author the marketplace blurb if results look positive.

sophia: Manifest published: https://go/redwood/bench/silkroad/manifest.md  includes env matrix, kernel commits, fw shas, and expected output schema.

ana: Scheduling: dry-run Mon 07:00 PT; canary Mon 09:00 PT; full sweep Wed 23:00 PT (overnight). If canary passes we'll label artifacts "partner-reviewed" and produce the 1-page marketplace entry highlighting perf/W deltas and methodology.

bench-bot: scheduled dry-run Mon 07:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.

mike: Action items: coaction-eng attach board serials & fw sha; sophia publish perf script; bench-bot ensure artifact tags; ana consolidate playbook and post marketplace draft after sweep.

ana: Thanks team — post any blockers here (FW regressions, thermal alarms, infra conflicts).
